facility.name: Angela Ielati
facility.programs_provided: Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report: The most recent inspection form was not posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report (26 TAC §747.401(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The children's product certification form was last signed on 7/11/25. This was corrected during the inspection when the primary caregiver signed a new form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points: Part of the playscape had cracked, resulting in a a small gap with sharp edges that could pinch or cut a child's fingers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §747.4401(7))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Logs Maintained: Sign-in sheets had not been completed since the beginning of September.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Logs Maintained (26 TAC §747.635(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: One child was missing an admission date, one child's parent had not signed that they received the operational policies, and one child had an immunization expemtion affidavit that wasn't notarized.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Three outlets did not have covers. This was corrected during the inspection when the outlet covers were placed back in the outlets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §747.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: There was a mop bucket with liquid in it accessible to children. This was corrected during the inspection when the mop bucket was emptied.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §747.3501(9))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Equipment and Water Hoses Kept Out of Child's Reach: There was a hose in the backyard where the children were playing. This was corrected during the inspection when the primary caregiver put the hose away.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Equipment and Water Hoses Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §747.4815(c))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: One of the dogs in the home had expired vaccinations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures- Sanitizing the Diapering Area: The primary caregiver did not sanitize the diaper changing mat after changing a child's diaper. This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver was reminded about sanitizing the changing mat and she sanitized the mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures- Sanitizing the Diapering Area (26 TAC §747.3307(d))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation: The primary caregiver's husband did not have record of completing orientation to the childcare home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation (26 TAC §747.905(2))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides- Six Feet High or Less: There was a playset with a slide that was placed under the empty swing bay of another play structure.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides- Six Feet High or Less (26 TAC §747.4605(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Out of four children's records reviewed, two were missing health statements, one was missing the parent's acknowledgment that they received the parent handbook, and one was missing a physician's information and consent to emergency medical treatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: The primary caregiver was missing 23 hours of annual training, including four hours of child development, six hours of management training, and training in emergency preparedness, administering medication, preventing allergic reactions, injury prevention, and handling hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Multiple outlets in the home were missing covers. This was corrected during the inspection when covers were placed in the outlets that were missing them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §747.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: The children in care were watching a movie, and one of the children was 23 months old. This was corrected during the inspection when I informed the primary caregiver that children under two cannot have any screen time and she turned off the television.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment- Multiple Occupancy Swings: There was a swing set with a multiple occupancy swing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment- Multiple Occupancy Swings (26 TAC §747.4403(5))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A child did not wash hands after getting their diaper changed. This was corrected during the inspection when the primary caregiver was reminded about handwashing and took the child to wash hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §747.3213(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Several outlets did not have covers. This was corrected during the inspection when the primary caregiver put covers in the outlets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §747.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Out of four children's records reviewed, three were missing a date of admission, one was missing physician's information and a health statement, and one was missing school information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: There was no recorded fire drills, severe weather, or lockdown drills for 2025. During the inspection, a fire drill was conducted and the children were able to exit in less than three minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Complete Kit: The first aid kit was missing scissors, adhesive tape and a guide to first aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Complete Kit (26 TAC §747.3803(a))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: One dog had an expired rabies vaccination.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The children's product recall verification form was last signed in 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The parent handbook was missing information on parent's rights, contact information for Child Care Regulation, and information on how to view the most recent licensing report.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §747.207(1))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: The primary caregiver was missing 3.5 hours of annual training, including training in communcable diseases.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation has not completed a fire drill since July of 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File: There were 2 children in care that did not have a health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Record Upon Admission: There were 2 children in care that did not have immunization records on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Record Upon Admission (26 TAC §747.613(c))

occurrences.finding: Must Have at Least One 3A-40BC Dry Chemical Fire Extinguisher or Fire Extinguisher Approved by Fire Marshal: During the inspection the provider did not have the required fire extinguisher.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Must Have at Least One 3A-40BC Dry Chemical Fire Extinguisher or Fire Extinguisher Approved by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §747.5103)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plan: During the inspection the operation did not have a emergency predareness plan in place.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plan (26 TAC §747.501(12))

occurrences.finding: Registered or Licensed Child-Care Home Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System, unless located in a School Facility: During the inspection the operation did not have a carbon monoxide in the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Registered or Licensed Child-Care Home Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System, unless located in a School Facility (26 TAC §747.5331)

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: During the inspection two dogs were observed a the operation without proof of vaccinations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: HRC42.052(d) - Illegal Operation - Not Registered: Based on the investigation, it was determined that 4 unrelated children were in care that meet the definition of regular care by the State of Texas.
occurrences.violation_type_title: HRC42.052(d) - Illegal Operation - Not Registered (26 TAC §HRC42.052(d) - Illegal Operation - Not R)
